GRAY = (128, 128, 128)

pygame.display.set_caption("Night Woods Shooter")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

# Player

monsters = []
for _ in range(5):
    monster = pygame.Rect(
        random.randint(0, SCREEN_WIDTH - MONSTER_SIZE),
        random.randint(0, SCREEN_HEIGHT - MONSTER_SIZE),
        MONSTER_SIZE, MONSTER_SIZE
    )
    monsters.append(monster)

# Trees
trees = []
for i in range(TREE_COUNT):
    tree_x = random.randint(0, SCREEN_WIDTH - TREE_WIDTH)
    tree_y = random.randint(0, SCREEN_HEIGHT - TREE_HEIGHT)
    trees.append(pygame.Rect(tree_x, tree_y, TREE_WIDTH, TREE_HEIGHT))

score = 0
lives = PLAYER_LIVES
game_over = False

    # Handle events
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                running = False
            if event.key == pygame.K_SPACE:
                # Shoot bullet
                bullet = pygame.Rect(
                    player.x + player.width // 2 - BULLET_SIZE // 2,
                    player.y,
                    BULLET_SIZE,
                    BULLET_SIZE
                )
                bullets.append(bullet)

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] and player.x > 0:

    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] and player.x < SCREEN_WIDTH - PLAYER_SIZE:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP] and player.y > 0:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN] and player.y < SCREEN_HEIGHT - PLAYER_SIZE:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    for bullet in bullets[:]:
        bullet.y -= BULLET_SPEED
        if bullet.y < 0 or bullet.colliderect(player):
            bullets.remove(bullet)

    # Move monsters
    for monster in monsters[:]:
        # Simple AI: move toward player if not blocked by tree
        monster_x = monster.x
        monster_y = monster.y
        player_x = player.x + PLAYER_SIZE // 2
        player_y = player.y + PLAYER_SIZE // 2

        # Check if monster is behind a tree
        tree_blocking = False
        for tree in trees:
            if tree.colliderect(monster):
                tree_blocking = True
                break

        if not tree_blocking:
            # Move monster toward player
            if monster_x < player_x:
                monster_x += MONSTER_SPEED
            elif monster_x > player_x:
                monster_x -= MONSTER_SPEED
            if monster_y < player_y:
                monster_y += MONSTER_SPEED
            elif monster_y > player_y:
                monster_y -= MONSTER_SPEED
            monster.x = monster_x
            monster.y = monster_y

        # Check if monster is out of bounds
        if monster.x < 0 or monster.x > SCREEN_WIDTH or monster.y < 0 or monster.y > SCREEN_HEIGHT:
            monsters.remove(monster)

    # Check for collisions
    for bullet in bullets[:]:
        for monster in monsters[:]:
            if bullet.colliderect(monster):
                bullets.remove(bullet)
                monsters.remove(monster)
                score += 1
                break

    # Check if player is hit by monster
    for monster in monsters:
        if player.colliderect(monster):
            lives -= 1
            monsters.remove(monster)
            if lives <= 0:
                game_over = True

    # Draw everything
    screen.fill(BLACK)
    for tree in trees:
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, GREEN, tree)
    for monster in monsters:
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, RED, monster)
    for bullet in bullets:
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, WHITE, bullet)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, BLUE, player)
    # Draw score and lives
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 36)
    score_text = font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, WHITE)
    lives_text = font.render(f"Lives: {lives}", True, WHITE)
    screen.blit(score_text, (10, 10))
    screen.blit(lives_text, (10, 50))
    if game_over:
        game_over_text = font.render("GAME OVER", True, WHITE)
        screen.blit(game_over_text, (SCREEN_WIDTH // 2 - 100, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2))

    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(FPS)

pygame.quit()

        monster_x = monster.x
        monster_y = monster.y
        player_x = player.x + PLAYER_SIZE // 2
        player_y = player.y + PLAYER_SIZE // 2

        # Check if monster is behind a tree
        tree_blocking = False
        for tree in trees:
            if tree.colliderect(monster):
                tree_blocking = True
                break

        if not tree_blocking:
            # Move monster toward player
            if monster_x < player_x:
                monster_x += MONSTER_SPEED
            elif monster_x > player_x:
                monster_x -= MONSTER_SPEED
            if monster_y < player_y:
                monster_y += MONSTER_SPEED
            elif monster_y > player_y:
                monster_y -= MONSTER_SPEED
            monster.x = monster_x
            monster.y = monster_y

        # Check if monster is out of bounds
        if monster.x < 0 or monster.x > SCREEN_WIDTH or monster.y < 0 or monster.y > SCREEN_HEIGHT:
            monsters.remove(monster)

    # Check for collisions
    for bullet in bullets[:]:
        for monster in monsters[:]:
            if bullet.colliderect(monster):
                bullets.remove(bullet)
                monsters.remove(monster)
                score += 1
                break

    # Check if player is hit by monster
    for monster in monsters:
        if player.colliderect(monster):
            lives -= 1
            monsters.remove(monster)
            if lives <= 0:
                game_over = True

    # Draw everything
    scene.update()
    screen.fill(BLACK)
    scene.draw()
    for monster in monsters:
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, RED, monster)
    for bullet in bullets:
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, WHITE, bullet)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, BLUE, player)
    # Draw score and lives
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 36)
    score_text = font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, WHITE)
    lives_text = font.render(f"Lives: {lives}", True, WHITE)
    screen.blit(score_text, (10, 10))
    screen.blit(lives_text, (10, 50))
    if game_over:
        game_over_text = font.render("GAME OVER", True, WHITE)
        screen.blit(game_over_text, (SCREEN_WIDTH // 2 - 100, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2))

    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(FPS)

pygame.quit()
